- Build a complete, playable open-city first-person game inspired by Half-Life.

- Built the game as a single-page browser experience in `index.html`, with desktop and mobile controls.

content.text:
Built **City 17: Afterlight** in `index.html` as a playable first-person city exploration game.

Explore the district, collect four signal cores, then activate the emergency relay at the tram terminal. Controls include WASD, sprint, jump, E to interact, and Q to pulse-scan; touch controls are also included.

I used original procedural Three.js scenery and a handmade crowbar-style viewmodel rather than proprietary Half-Life assets. The game loaded in the browser, and I captured and inspected a small JPEG screenshot. Preview server: `http://localhost:3002`.
